description: Ranks USDC lending and tokenized-treasury yields across Solana, Ethereum, Base and Arbitrum (DefiLlama data) by risk-adjusted APY instead of headline APY. Each pool's APY is discounted for volatility, TVL depth, protocol risk, DefiLlama's stability prediction, reward-emission dependence and impermanent-loss exposure; every entry carries a riskScore (0-100), a riskFactors breakdown and riskNotes explaining the discount. Pools with a riskScore below 25 are tiered speculative and listed after all others, whatever their APY. Solana pools are marked executable (autoyield can prepare a deposit); other chains are informational. The response includes topExecutable (best risk-adjusted executable pool) and topByRiskAdjustedOverall (best across all chains); topByRiskAdjusted is a deprecated alias of topExecutable. fixedRateAlternatives (when present) lists the largest stablecoin Pendle PTs: a fixed rate to maturity, kept apart from the ranking, never executable here, with measured evidence of how fixed rates compared with the floating yield actually paid. Read-only.

amountUsdc.description: Optional intended deposit size for impact estimation
